exercises.why: **Избавьте** — изба́вить (perfective): to rid, to save, to relieve. Wiktionary: из- + -ба́вить.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **изберут** — избра́ть (perfective): to choose, to elect. Wiktionary: из- + брать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **избрали** — избра́ть (perfective): to choose, to elect. Wiktionary: из- + брать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to disorder, to disturb, to unsettle
to look at, to peruse, to examine
to excuse, to pardon, to forgive
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: расстро́ить — to disorder, to disturb, to unsettle; рассмотре́ть — to look at, to peruse, to examine; изво́лить — (dated, ironic) to desire, to wish; извини́ть — to excuse, to pardon, to forgive.
**Изложите** — изложи́ть (perfective): to expound, to explain, to state, to set forth, to relate, to retell. Wiktionary: из- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Изложи** — изложи́ть (perfective): to expound, to explain, to state, to set forth, to relate, to retell. Wiktionary: из- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry out, to fulfill, to execute
to be frightened (of), to be startled (of), to take fright (at); to shy (at)
to change, to alter, to modify, to edit
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: испо́лнить — to carry out, to fulfill, to execute; испуга́ться — to be frightened (of), to be startled (of), to take fright (at); to shy (at); измени́ть — to change, to alter, to modify, to edit; изве́стие — news, tidings.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to spoil, to ruin, to mar, to damage
to rid, to save, to relieve
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: испыта́ть — to try, to test; испо́ртить — to spoil, to ruin, to mar, to damage; изда́ть — to publish, to print; изба́вить — to rid, to save, to relieve.
